question: Ricky Kej won his third Grammy under which of the following categories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Best Immersive Audio Album.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ricky Kej:-**

 
 
• Ricky Kej was born on August 5, 1981, in North Carolina, United States.
 
• He displayed a strong interest in music from a young age and began learning the piano at the age of 3.
 
• **He won his third Grammy under the category of Best Immersive Audio Album.**
 
• Ricky Kej's music is characterized by its fusion of various genres, blending elements of classical, pop, jazz, and world music.
 
• His compositions often convey messages of environmental conservation, social awareness, and cultural diversity.
 
 
 
• **Best Immersive Audio Album:-**
 
 
• It is a category that recognizes albums with an **immersive surround sound experience.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Song of the Year:-

 
 
• It​ is a category that recognizes the songwriters and composers of a single song.
 
 
 
• Best Contemporary Instrumental Album:-
 
 
• It is a category that recognizes instrumental albums that are contemporary in style.
 
 
 
• Album of the Year:-
 
 
• It is a category that recognizes the overall artistic achievement, technical proficiency, and excellence in sound recording of an album.
